name: Witches
overview: Scripture clearly condemns witchcraft and those who engage with familiar spirits or wizards, commanding that such individuals must not be allowed to live, as seen in Exodus 22:18 and Leviticus 20:27. The Lord warns His people not to seek out or be defiled by these practices, declaring His opposition to souls who turn to them and threatening their removal from the community (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6). Additionally, believers are instructed to avoid adopting the abominable customs of surrounding nations, emphasizing holiness and separation from the works of the flesh, which include various sins listed in Galatians 5:19.
